button.label: Add Sample
button.supertip: Appends a fresh 12-column sample block to the right.

button.label: Remove Sample
button.supertip: Deletes the rightmost 12-column sample block. Asks first.

button.label: Reset Formulas
button.screentip: Reset formulas in the active block
button.supertip: Click inside a sample block first. Restores formulas without touching your data.

button.label: First
button.supertip: Moves the selection to column C on the current row.

button.label: Prev Sample
button.supertip: Moves the selection 12 columns left (one sample block). Clamps at column C.

button.label: Next Sample
button.supertip: Moves the selection 12 columns right (one sample block). Clamps at the last sample column (CI).

button.label: Last
button.screentip: Jump to last sample with a header
button.supertip: Scans row 4 for the rightmost non-empty sample header and jumps there on the current row.

button.label: Sheet Guide
button.screentip: How the TPM sheet works + the dropdowns
button.supertip: The 12-column sample-block layout, every dropdown (heating tech, voltage, puffs, clog, smell), and the auto-calculated columns you should not type into.

button.label: Sample Tools
button.screentip: Sample blocks, puffs auto-fill, and shortcuts
button.supertip: Add / Remove Sample, Reset Formulas, the puffs auto-fill, and the Ctrl+Shift+. / , navigation shortcuts.

button.label: Instructions
button.supertip: Step-by-step instructions for selecting tests and uploading to DataViewer.

button.label: Upload All
button.supertip: Runs the checklist, copies the data to Synology + Local + DataViewer, then resets each uploaded sheet (a '- Review' copy is kept).

button.label: Specify Test Name
button.screentip: Label this file with a project / test name
button.supertip: Saves the workbook as '<your name> - <original file name>' so parallel-project copies are distinguishable at a glance. Upload All automatically restores the original name.

button.label: Delete All Review Sheets
button.supertip: One click removes all '- Review' sheets. Canonical, template, and utility sheets are never touched.
